name: Rune Knight
summary: A warrior who carves giant runes into gear and grows to giant size.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.short: Smith's tools and the Giant language.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and learn Giant.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.short: Inscribe runes with passive bonuses and a power.
features.summary: You learn two runes and inscribe them on your gear; each gives a passive benefit and can be invoked once per short or long rest. You learn another rune at 7th, 10th and 15th level. Save DC = 8 + PB + CON.

options.name: Cloud Rune
options.summary: Advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception; reaction to redirect an attack to another creature.

options.name: Fire Rune
options.summary: Double proficiency with tools; on a hit, restrain the target in fiery shackles (+2d6 fire per turn).

options.name: Frost Rune
options.summary: Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation; bonus action +2 to STR and CON checks and saves.

options.name: Stone Rune
options.summary: Advantage on Insight; darkvision 120 ft.; reaction to charm a creature into a trance.

options.name: Hill Rune
options.summary: Advantage on saves against poison; resistance to poison; bonus action resistance to physical damage.

options.name: Storm Rune
options.summary: Advantage on Arcana; can't be surprised; bonus action to grant advantage or disadvantage with a reaction.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.short: Bonus action: grow Large, advantage on STR, +1d6 damage.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you become Large for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, and once per turn your weapon or unarmed attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.short: Reaction: force an attacker to reroll.
features.summary: When a creature within 60 ft. is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll and use the new roll. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.short: Grow 3d4 inches; Giant's Might bonus becomes 1d8.
features.summary: You grow 3d4 inches taller, and the extra damage from Giant's Might becomes 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.short: Invoke each rune twice per rest.
features.summary: You can invoke each rune you know twice, instead of once, between rests.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.short: Giant's Might makes you Huge with 1d10 extra damage.
features.summary: Giant's Might's extra damage becomes 1d10, you can become Huge, and your reach increases by 5 ft. while transformed.
